response.sql:
WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
),
station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT 
  sa.observstation,
  sa.station_avg_usage,
  sa.station_avg_usage - oa.avg_usage as margin
FROM station_avgs sa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE sa.station_avg_usage > oa.avg_usage
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "How much it exceeds" is interpreted as absolute difference (station_avg - overall_avg), not percentage excess or ratio
NULL values in bandusagepct are excluded from all average calculations, which is standard SQL AVG() behavior
